text:
maria: Quick sync — finalizing the GPU return 'gatecheck' after soak. Posting the acceptance criteria and a short job snippet. Need sign-off before we enable auto-unmarking in the repair runbook.

jonah: +1 to getting this formalized. can you paste the exact thresholds?

maria: Sure. TL;DR: 48h soak, 2 independent repro attempts, zero persistent XID errors, ECC corrected errors <= 1 per card per 48h, perf regression <= 2% vs baseline for 1k token generation. Functional tests (nv-runner) must pass 3/3 on pinned model.

sean: Are we comfortable with 48h for all card types? older A100s might need longer. Suggest 72h for anything flagged twice in 30d.

kai: Agree on the 72h fallback. Also request we capture thermal cycling traces + BMC logs for any that fail repro. That helps root cause.

maria: Good point. Updated rule: 48h default, 72h if card has >1 transient XID or ECC spike in 30d. Include BMC/thermal on fail.

ops-bot: soak-run job queued: job_id=soak-2026-03-15-42, nodes=10, duration=48h, profile=mem+power+continuous-gen

jonah: Question: what are the repro vectors for 'targeted repro attempts'?

maria: Two repro vectors: 1) Memory sweep: run cuda-memtest variant for 8h across all visible regions; 2) Production-like stream: concurrent 12x 2k-token generation with KV cache warm, repeat for 4h. Both must be run on same card.

sean: Add an intermittent reboot stress: soft-reset the GPU (nvidia-smi --gpu-reset) every 6h during the memtest to catch init race conditions.

kai: Also run power-cycling on the node between repro attempts. we've seen errors that only show up after a power event.

maria: Noted — will add power-cycling between repro attempts. Will include an automated BMC ipmi power-cycle step in the job.

jonah: For instrumentation, can we tag traces with soak_id and node_serial so we can rollup stats?

maria: Yes — soak_id env + tags. Also pushing a patch to telemetry to capture ECC counters per-GPU every 30s and Xid events with nvml timestamps.

ops-bot: telemetry-patch deployed to staging (rev: t-3f2). Metric names: gpu.ecc.corrected, gpu.ecc.uncorrected, gpu.xid.events, gpu.temp.max

sean: What about acceptance on flaky performance? perf regression <=2% is fine but we should run percentile latency (p95) checks too.

maria: We'll assert both mean throughput and p95. p95 must not degrade more than 10%.

kai: One ops process note: mark node as 'repair:soak' then 'repair:quarantine' if fails. automated drain->soak->repro->pass: auto-unmark. fail: leave quarantined and create a ticket.

jonah: How about cost? 48h on 10 nodes is expensive. Can we run memtest in parallel across fewer cards first and escalate if borderline?

maria: Yes — staged approach: quick smoke (2h memtest + 1h stream) on all suspect cards; only escalate to full 48h for those that show anomalies. That saves ~60% compute on average.

kai: Love the staged plan. Also add a flag to force 72h for specific SKUs.

sean: Anything else for the runbook? I want a clear 'return checklist' snippet for oncall to follow.

maria: Draft checklist (will put in PR):
```
- Confirm node drained and workloads evacuated
- Set label: repair:soak and create soak ticket
- Run staged smoke on all GPUs (2h memtest + 1h stream)
- If anomaly -> full soak (48h/72h) with memtest+stream+reboot+power-cycle
- Run two repro attempts; collect nvml, BMC, dmesg, kernel logs
- Validate perf/p95 and ECC/XID thresholds
- If pass -> remove repair:soak label and mark as returned in ticket
- If fail -> label repair:quarantine, attach diagnostics, trigger replacement workflow
```

ops-bot: created ticket INFRA-5923 for soak-run details and automation toggles

jonah: I reviewed — :thumbsup: from me. small nit: change 'two repro attempts' wording to 'two independent repro runs separated by power-cycle'

maria: Done. I'll open the PR for the runbook and the automation flags. If no blockers I'll flip auto-unmark next week.

kai: Approved from my side.

sean: Approved. Go ahead.

maria: Thanks all — merging changes and will post link once PR is live.
